explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/508: with χ the chromatic number of the plane, 'There are several small graphs that show χ ≥ 4 (in particular the Moser spindle and Golomb graph).' The Lean statement 4 ≤ χ(ℝ²), where χ(ℝ²) is the chromaticNumber (in ℕ∞) of the unit-distance graph on all of ℝ² (points adjacent iff at distance 1), is exactly this classical bound. Faithful.
